note: CodeOS agent roles served READ-ONLY by CoeOS SE. SE has no customisation surface on purpose: the models come from the official TMB settings it ships. Each role declares the skill axes it routes on; `panel` marks a diversity group whose members must end up on DIFFERENT models, or a contradiction between them is not a contradiction.

codeos-reviewer.label: CodeOS Reviewer
codeos-reviewer.note: CodeOS agent (opencode desktop fork): adversarial review of a diff. Consumed by buildCoeosConfig, not by orchestrator.py — same routing brain (score-table+pairs), interactive harness distinct from the headless superagent.

codeos-explore.label: CodeOS Explore
codeos-explore.note: Read-only by construction (no write tools on the CodeOS side); weights speed like the superagent executor (high call frequency).

codeos-panel-direct.label: CodeOS Panel — Direct
codeos-panel-direct.note: Panel member: takes the position head-on. The three panel roles are a DIVERSITY group — `panel` forces distinct models across them, because a contradiction between two instances of the same model is not a contradiction. They pin a concrete model instead of the router (routing by axis would collapse them onto one model).

codeos-panel-alternative.label: CodeOS Panel — Alternative
codeos-panel-alternative.note: Panel member: argues the alternative. Must be a DIFFERENT model family from Direct — see the `panel` group.

codeos-panel-sceptique.label: CodeOS Panel — Skeptic
codeos-panel-sceptique.note: Panel member: red-teams both. Third distinct model of the `panel` group.

codeos-orchestrator.label: CodeOS Orchestrator
codeos-orchestrator.note: CodeOS CoeOS Mode (PLAN.md v2 WU3): the primary agent that plans work into the Task File and dispatches role-scoped subagents. Never edits files itself. Consumed by buildCoeosConfig, not by orchestrator.py.

codeos-executor.label: CodeOS Executor
codeos-executor.note: CodeOS CoeOS Mode: the write-enabled subagent that implements exactly one Task File task. Reachable only through CoeOS Mode dispatch (runtime guard in TaskTool).
